description: Takes a Maven or Gradle project that builds on a Spring Boot line below this architecture's floor up to it — the version bump, the renamed starters and test slices, the renamed configuration properties — and leaves the build green and the diff uncommitted. Use when `/arch-adopt` or `export` refused a project for its Spring Boot line, or when a project should move up before adopting. Explicit invocation only.
